critic_risk_flags: Although H aligns semantically with hospitalization rate, adding an explicit H compartment in SEIHR increases complexity and identifiability risk for a short single-season series (n_train=31), consistent with the stated risk note. Likely to create unstable separation between I and H timing/scale without strong information in the data.

Fractional memory adds flexibility that is hard to justify with 31 training points and moderate peakiness; high risk of overfitting and weak identifiability of the fractional parameter. Also, delayed_I with delay=1 conflicts with the stronger plausibility of ~2-week lag already supported by current discovery patterns.
